subject: mathematics
title: Number Face-Off
objective: Compare numbers up to 10,000 using =, >, and <.
introduction: Milo compares mango baskets and game scores. Can you decide which number is greater, smaller, or equal?

vocabulary.definition: Compare thousands first; then 2 hundreds is more than 0 hundreds.
Both have 3 thousands, but 1 hundred is less than 9 hundreds.
Every place matches, so the two amounts are equal.

items.prompt: Milo has 4,205 mangoes in one basket and 4,025 in another. Which comparison is true?
items.explanation: Both have 4 thousands. Compare hundreds: 2 is greater than 0, so 4,205 > 4,025.

items.prompt: Two stalls show 3,100 and 3,900 points. Which comparison is correct?
items.explanation: Both start with 3 thousands. Compare hundreds: 1 is less than 9, so 3,100 < 3,900.

items.prompt: Two boxes each hold 6,450 beads. Which number sentence is true?
items.explanation: 6,450 equals 6,450 because all digits in the thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones places are identical.

items.prompt: A score of 8,001 is compared with 7,999. Which comparison is correct?
items.explanation: 8,001 has 8 thousands and 7,999 has 7 thousands. 8 > 7, so 8,001 > 7,999.

items.prompt: Milo compares 6,030 and 6,003. Which pair is compared correctly?
items.explanation: Compare from the greatest place: both have 6 thousands, but 6,030 has 3 tens while 6,003 has 0, so 6,030 > 6,003.
